_about: The learning outcomes the self-tests are checked against (selftest.py coverage). The wording is shortened from the study programme; 'pages' are the topic pages whose videos teach the outcome, empty when no video does yet. 'practical' outcomes are trained in the skills lab, not in a multiple-choice test.

R-organ.da: Identificere organprogrammer og følge en simpel procedure ved valg af organprogram
R-organ.en: Identify organ programs and follow a simple procedure for choosing one

R-krystal.en: Explain the properties of the crystals in the image plate/flat panel

R-billede.da: Forklare opbygningen af det digitale billede
R-billede.en: Explain how the digital image is built up

R-lut.en: Explain the dynamic range and the LUT

R-udl.en: Describe the readout of the signal

R-spredt.da: Vurdere primær- og sekundærstrålingens betydning for røntgenbilledet
R-spredt.en: Assess what primary and secondary radiation do to the image

R-lab.da: Anvende udvalgte parametre ved billeddannelse i færdighedslaboratoriet
R-lab.en: Use selected parameters when making images in the skills lab

Q-absorber.da: Vurdere billedkvalitet: absorbers karakteristika, fotoelektrisk effekt og comptonspredning
Q-absorber.en: Assess image quality: the absorber, photoelectric effect and Compton scatter

Q-forvr.en: Assess image quality: distortion and superimposition

Q-vaev.da: Beskrive hvordan de valgte parametre ændrer vævenes fremtræden i billedet
Q-vaev.en: Describe how the chosen parameters change how tissues show in the image

U-fysik.da: Beskrive og demonstrere generelle ultralydsprincipper: fysik
U-fysik.en: Describe and demonstrate general principles: physics

U-scanner.da: Beskrive og demonstrere generelle ultralydsprincipper: scannerens opbygning
U-scanner.en: Describe and demonstrate general principles: how the scanner is built

U-artefakt.da: Beskrive og demonstrere generelle ultralydsprincipper: artefakter
U-artefakt.en: Describe and demonstrate general principles: artefacts

U-doppler.da: Beskrive og demonstrere generelle ultralydsprincipper: Doppler
U-doppler.en: Describe and demonstrate general principles: Doppler

U-sikker.da: Beskrive og demonstrere generelle ultralydsprincipper: sikkerhed
U-sikker.en: Describe and demonstrate general principles: safety

U-aorta.en: Normal aorta and abdominal aortic aneurysm

U-dvt.en: The leg veins, with a focus on DVT

U-nyre.da: Nyrer og blære: cyster, tumorer, hydronefrose, urinretention
U-nyre.en: Kidneys and bladder: cysts, tumours, hydronephrosis, urinary retention

U-lever.da: Lever, pancreas, milt og galdeblære: cyster, fedt, sten, kolecystit m.m.
U-lever.en: Liver, pancreas, spleen and gallbladder: cysts, fat, stones, cholecystitis and more
